profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Fifth Third Bank
profile.summary:
Throughout my career I have had a front-seat to the technology revolution where I have participated in innovations of many types.  I am known for delivering game-changing, reliable, cost-saving solutions that support global IT systems and software development for a variety of clients, ranging from the U.S. Airforce to large telephony providers. 

Technical Proficiencies: 

OPERATING SYSTEMS / PLATFORMS: 	Microsoft Windows, Win32/COM/.NET, macOS, Linux, Microservices, RESTful technologies, IBM 10x, WebSphere MQ, GitHub
LANGUAGES: 			                Java, C++, C#, Smalltalk, C, Maven, Jython, JavaScript, HTML
DEVELOPMENT TOOLS: 			Kafka, Microsoft Visual Studio, Eclipse, Git, Distributed Processing
CONTAINERS: 			                Docker, Kubernetes, Blockchain 
DATABASE / SERVERS: 			        Jenkins, MongoDB, DB2, IBM Cloud, Servlets
SDLC TOOLS: 			                Session Initiation Protocol (SIP), Internet Protocol Suite (TCP/IP), Transport Layer Security (TLS), X.12, EDIFACT Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) Documents

positions.title: Advisory Software Engineer
positions.description:
I have spent over two decades with IBM transforming leading edge research concepts into code suitable for development team consumption, use, and integration. Additionally, I work hard to generate detailed project work documentation that is suitable for handover to product management and development teams.

I have designed, developed, and supported a series of six products across several different commercial product lines. 
The following are just a snapshot of what I have accomplished during my tenure at IBM:

WEBSPHERE APPLICATION SERVER AUGMENTATION
•	Added Session Initiation Protocol (SIP) functionality to WebSphere Application Server, developing SIP proxy with high availability (HA) and failover capabilities.
•	Designed User Datagram Protocol (UDP) Channel and business logic to route SIP communications to backend SIP containers. 
•	Achieved throughput of 100,000 SIP requests/responses per second while sustaining HA capabilities. 
•	Contributed to landing $1B AT&T deal with superior quality code, strong collaboration, and solid communication.

BLOCKCHAIN DOCUMENT SERVICE (BDS) OPTIMIZATION
•	Researched alternatives to costly billing and metering service that collected data from BTI+ product for accounting reasons. 
•	Delivered well-designed Chain code and Hyperledger components for EDI document validation at both server and UI layer.
•	Implemented new Blockchain service in three months, dramatically improving solution performance from day one. 
•	Saved Business Transaction Intelligence Plus (BTI+) product ~$1,000 per month in subscription fees.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
In this role, I built modules used in Unisys ET1000 terminal emulation for an array of Unix-flavored operating systems such as virtual printers, firmware for intelligent communications card and device driver, and file transfer utilities. 

Key Contributions:

•	Conceptualized, planned, and built PC X-server used to facilitate communications between Windows PC’s and Unix systems running X-Windows.
•	Co-designed and developed software to accelerate file transfers 10-fold, providing larger enterprise banking customers more secure communications. 
•	Laid groundwork for Irma-X, later rebranded KEA-X, modifying device layers to work under Windows 95.
•	Enabled Attachmate to enter Windows X-Server business to complement virtual terminal emulator product offering.

company.name: ICC (Acquired by Digital Communications Associates and Attachmate Corp.)

positions.title: Embedded Software Developer
positions.description:
I was engaged by SRL to port four different operating systems to proprietary computer system used for aircraft diagnostics. 

Key Contributions: 

•	Wrote bootstrap code for operating system and created unique drivers for over several different devices. 
•	Expanded United States Air Force (USAF)’s diagnostic capabilities, porting System V Unix, OS/9, Ada, and     Smalltalk/V into portable computer.

positions.title: Database Programmer
positions.description:
At LSA, I coded and designed data entry programs using Plexus Unix environment and Unify Database solution.

Key Contributions:
•	Supported quality assurance goals critical to the US Air Force’s logistics modernization effort.
